svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Sylfaen, Noto Sans Georgian, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
svg.text: Green: one bone, a tourniquet works. Red: two bones, go higher.
head injury: lie on the side
neck hurt: hold the jaw still
don't move the head or neck
on the back, hard flat surface
on the back, roll under knees
One bone: a tourniquet presses the artery
Two bones: the artery hides between them
